personality: 7 Dark-First Utility DARK with 6 Glass / Luxe typography and surfacing (Black & Gold)
personality_one_liner: A luxurious, strong (gagah), and highly readable command center for police HR data, anchored in midnight black and official gold.

spacing.rule: Use tight padding for data cards to keep them scannable. Generous margins at the screen root. Maintain safe-area for sticky bottom actions.

do's: Use heavy glass headers over the scrolling personnel list
Use glass overlays on the dark gold abstract hero background for the search area
dont's: No glass on form inputs or dense HR data cards

screens.name: Dashboard / Search
screens.purpose: Public landing screen to quickly search personnel by Name/NRP and see total leave stats.

states.loading: Spinner centered on deep obsidian background.

screens.layout: Header: Hero section with 'gold_luxury_abstract' background, a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim, and a massive Search Input (Name/NRP). Below Header: Horizontal scroll of Year and Satfung chips (brandTertiary with gold active state). Body: Bento-style stat cards (Total Personil, Sedang Cuti) followed by a list of recently updated personnel.

screens.name: Personnel Profile
screens.purpose: Detailed view of a single person's HR details and grouped leave history.

states.empty: No leave history recorded for this year.

screens.layout: Hero: Large initials avatar in a Gold circle, large Oswald name, and structural details (Pangkat, NRP, Jabatan). Body: Sectioned list of leave types (Izin 1, Izin 2, Emergency, Cuti Tahunan, Berobat, Umroh/Haji/Lainnya). Each leave record is a dark charcoal card with a gold left-border indicator, showing Date and Alasan. Sticky CTA at bottom for Admin: 'Edit Data'.

screens.name: Admin Login
screens.purpose: Secure gateway for Bag SDM admins to edit data.
screens.layout: Modal or Stack push. Dark screen, centered form. Gold borders on focus (`borderStrong`). Solid gold primary CTA.

screens.name: Admin Management
screens.purpose: Admin tools to upload Excel and manually edit/add leave entries.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Dark-First Utility layout logic (dense, readable data rows, dividers over shadows, high contrast text) but apply the Glass / Luxe aesthetic (black and gold palette, heavy typography) to satisfy the 'mewah dan gagah' requirement.

Color Palette Constraint: The primary palette is DARK (midnight black background with gold accents). The 'color' object contains the dark theme. The 'color_light' object contains the corresponding light theme tokens if the app needs to support OS-level toggling, but DARK should be the default forced appearance if not toggled.
Typography: Use Oswald for prominent names, ranks, and numbers. Use DM Sans for the actual body data (reasons/alasan, dates) so it remains highly readable.
UI Chrome: Use 'brandTertiary' (#3D3012) for active filter chips and subtle gold background highlights. Use 'borderStrong' (#D4AF37) for focus states or to highlight an active/ongoing leave status.

Hero/Search: Implement the 'hero_abstract' image in the Home screen header. A 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface color) MUST be layered over it so the search bar and stats are fully legible.

Data Presentation: The personnel leave history is dense. Group them cleanly. Use left-border highlights on cards to separate 'Cuti' vs 'Izin'. Avoid over-using gold; keep it restricted to primary actions and selected states.

No auth wall for the main app: The Home and Profile screens are public (view-only). Only show 'Upload Excel' or 'Add Data' buttons if the user is authenticated as an Admin. Place a subtle 'Admin Login' icon in the header.
